svg.text: FRAME 01 / Existing: listProjects + listJobs + listModelProviders; activeRecordingId only.
PROPOSED B: real recording enumeration + native reopen; no new schema/provider.
A: current recording only. Existing lazy settings/pairing/recovery remain reachable.
FRAME 02 / Existing: liveMeetingStart/Stop + live events; summaries(projectId, recordingId).
Legacy ask: project filters transcript ONLY; graph/live tail may differ. B: scoped ask PROPOSED.
Navigate while recording: confirm keep recording / stop then leave / cancel.
FRAME 03 / Existing: transcript + summaries(projectId, recordingId); export job scoped likewise.
Existing listExportArtifacts(projectId): PROJECT scope. PROPOSED B: history/native audio/Q&A.
A: current-only; playback unavailable; local-knowledge ask with transcript-only project filter.
B: PCM16 WAV mono/stereo 8–96 kHz + matching output rate; capture blocks playback; other formats unavailable.
